entities.summary: Liu Jiyuan, also known by his regnal name as the Emperor Yingwu of (Northern) Han ( 漢英武帝), was the last emperor of the Shatuo-led Chinese Northern Han dynasty during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. He was the grandson of Liu Min. He ruled Northern Han from 968 until 979, when he surrendered to Song forces under the Emperor Taizong of Song.
